title: [3.0.0.2-dev-k] "Error CGM data unchanged for the past ~45m..."
symptom: User reports receiving an error message 'CGM data unchanged for the past ~45m...' even though CGM data was changing (values ranged from 4.7 to 5.1 mmol). The error cleared after about 30 minutes.
cause: The error is by design in AAPS for Libre sensors (FSL2 with patched LibreLink). It is a protection against a state where the FSL reports a constant (wrong) value for a longer time. The check uses delta and average delta over the period, which was close to zero in this case.
fix: No fix provided; it is by design. The restriction is not present when using Dexcom.
evidence_quote: then it's by OAPS design. it's protection from state when FSL report constant (wrong) value for a longer time This restriction is not while using Dexcom
